content.text: Got it. Pesagot account + Yalin Lapidot S&P fund, the "הזול" one. Costs 18,299 ₪ over 15 years, mostly pink = "מס" I guess. Enough.

input.answer: I'd open a securities account at פסגות ניירות ערך and buy the "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)" fund that the page marks "הזול". With 750 ₪ a month for 15 years (135,000 ₪ put in), it says I'd end up with about 179,889 ₪ "בכסף של היום", assuming 2% inflation a year and 7% return.

stuck.why: No number showed for inflation on the main screen. I only found the 2% by tapping the 'אינפלציה' button, which opened a box that also looks like something you can edit.
The colour legend sits below the bars and is tiny. I guessed the big pink part is 'מס' (tax).

skipped: Text about the dollar rate and the central bank
Rest of the page below the account/fund cards

not_found: A plain explanation of why the result is 'in today's money' without opening the inflation button
How much I'd have without taking inflation off

findings.what: The inflation assumption (2%) is hidden behind a button. The main result just says 'בכסף של היום' with no number next to it
findings.where: Line under the sliders / אינפלציה button

findings.what: The top two choices differ by only 122 ₪ over 15 years, so 'cheapest' doesn't really tell them apart
The colour legend for the cost bars is small and far from the bars, so I had to guess what pink means
The slider jumped to 800 while the field showed 750, which is confusing
The results don't explain how much of the total came from what I paid in and how much came from growth
